segments.ja516:1.1: Bārāṇasyaṃ [bārāṇassaṃ (sī. pī.)] ahū rājā, kāsīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano;
segments.ja516:4.1: “Hatthapādā ca te setā, tato setataraṃ [setataro (pī.)] siro;
segments.ja516:5.3: Kāḷapabbāva [kāḷapabbā ca (syā.), kāḷā pabbā ca (pī.)] te aṅgā, nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ.
segments.ja516:6.3: Chāto ātattarūposi [ādittarūposi (ka.), atittarūposi (syā. ka. aṭṭha.)], kutosi kattha gacchasi.
segments.ja516:7.3: Janetti yāpi te mātā, na taṃ iccheyya passituṃ.
segments.ja516:8.1: “Kiṃ kammamakaraṃ [kammamakarā (sī. syā. pī.)] pubbe, kaṃ avajjhaṃ aghātayi;
segments.ja516:8.3: Kibbisaṃ yaṃ karitvāna, idaṃ dukkhaṃ upāgami”.
segments.ja516:9.1: Taggha te ahamakkhissaṃ, yathāpi kusalo tathā;
segments.ja516:10.1: Eko caraṃ gogaveso, mūḷho accasariṃ vane;
segments.ja516:10.3: Araññe irīṇe [īriṇe (sī. syā. pī.)] vivane, nānākuñjarasevite.
segments.ja516:11.3: Acariṃ tattha sattāhaṃ, khuppipāsa [khuppipāsā (sī. pī.)] samappito.
segments.ja516:13.1: Vātassitāni bhakkhesiṃ, tāni rucciṃsu me bhusaṃ;
segments.ja516:13.3: Atitto rukkhamārūhiṃ [māruyha (sī. syā.)], tattha hessāmi āsito.
segments.ja516:14.1: Ekaṃ me bhakkhitaṃ āsi, dutiyaṃ abhipatthitaṃ;
segments.ja516:14.3: Tato sā bhañjatha sākhā, chinnā pharasunā viya.
segments.ja516:16.1: Yasmā ca vāri gambhīraṃ, tasmā na samapajjisaṃ [samapajjasiṃ (sī.), samabhajjisaṃ (pī.)];
segments.ja516:16.3: Tattha sesiṃ nirānando, anūnā [anātho (sī.)] dasa rattiyo.
segments.ja516:17.1: Athettha kapi māgañchi [māgacchi (syā. ka.)], gonaṅgulo darīcaro;
segments.ja516:18.1: So maṃ disvā kisaṃ paṇḍuṃ, kāruññamakaraṃ mayi;
segments.ja516:18.3: Ambho ko nāma so ettha, evaṃ dukkhena aṭṭito.
segments.ja516:19.1: Manusso amanusso vā, attānaṃ me pavedaya;
segments.ja516:20.1: Manussohaṃ byasampatto [vasampatto (syā. ka.)], sā me natthi ito gati;
segments.ja516:20.3: Taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddaṃ vo, tvañca me saraṇaṃ bhava.
segments.ja516:21.1: Garuṃ [garu (sī. pī.)] silaṃ gahetvāna, vicarī [vicari (pī.)] pabbate kapi;
segments.ja516:22.1: Ehi me piṭṭhimāruyha, gīvaṃ gaṇhāhi bāhubhi;
segments.ja516:23.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vānarindassa sirīmato;
segments.ja516:24.1: So maṃ tato samuṭṭhāsi, tejassī [tejasī (syā. pī. ka.)] balavā kapi;
segments.ja516:25.3: Iṅgha maṃ samma rakkhassu, passupissaṃ muhuttakaṃ.
segments.ja516:26.1: Sīhā byagghā ca dīpī ca, acchakokataracchayo;
segments.ja516:26.3: Te maṃ pamattaṃ hiṃseyyuṃ, te tvaṃ disvā nivāraya [disvāna vāraya (pī.)].
segments.ja516:27.1: Evaṃ me parittātūna [parittātuna (ka.)], passupi so muhuttakaṃ;
segments.ja516:28.1: Bhakkho ayaṃ manussānaṃ, yathā caññe vane migā;
segments.ja516:28.3: Yaṃ nūnimaṃ vadhitvāna, chāto khādeyya vānaraṃ.
segments.ja516:30.3: Mama gatta [bhatta (sī. syā.), hattha (pī.)] kilantassa, pahāro dubbalo ahu.
segments.ja516:31.1: So ca vegenudappatto, kapi ruhira [rudhira (sī.)] makkhito;
segments.ja516:32.1: Māyyomaṃ kari bhaddante, tvañca nāmedisaṃ kari;
segments.ja516:32.3: Tvañca kho nāma dīghāvu [dīghāyu (pī.)], aññe [aññaṃ (pī.)] vāretumarahasi.
segments.ja516:33.1: Aho vata re purisa, tāva dukkarakāraka;
segments.ja516:33.3: Edisā visamā duggā, papātā uddhato [uddhaṭo (pī.)] mayā.
segments.ja516:34.3: Taṃ tena pāpadhammena, pāpaṃ pāpena cintitaṃ.
segments.ja516:35.1: Mā heva tvaṃ adhammaṭṭha, vedanaṃ kaṭukaṃ phusi;
segments.ja516:35.3: Mā heva pāpakammaṃ taṃ, phalaṃ veḷuṃva taṃ vadhi.
segments.ja516:36.1: Tayime natthi vissāso, pāpadhamma asaññata [pāpadhammaṃ amaññatha (pī.)];
segments.ja516:36.3: Ehi me piṭṭhito gaccha, dissamānova santike.
segments.ja516:37.1: Muttosi hatthā vāḷānaṃ, pattosi mānusiṃ padaṃ;
segments.ja516:37.3: Esa maggo adhammaṭṭha, tena gaccha yathāsukhaṃ.
segments.ja516:38.1: Idaṃ vatvā giricaro, rahade [ruhiraṃ (syā. ka.)] pakkhalya matthakaṃ;
segments.ja516:41.3: Tāvanto gaṇḍa [gaṇḍū (sī. pī.), gaṇḍu (syā.)] jāyetha, addhabeluvasādisā.
segments.ja516:42.3: Yena yeneva gacchāmi, gāmesu nigamesu ca.
segments.ja516:43.1: Daṇḍahatthā nivārenti, itthiyo purisā ca maṃ;
segments.ja516:43.3: Okkitā [okiṇṇā (sī.)] pūtigandhena, māssu orena āgamā [māgamā (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja516:44.1: Etādisaṃ idaṃ dukkhaṃ, satta vassāni dāni me;
segments.ja516:45.1: Taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddante [bhaddaṃ vo (sī. pī.)], yāvantettha samāgatā;
segments.ja516:45.3: Māssu mittāna [mittānaṃ (sī. pī.)] dubbhittho, mittadubbho hi pāpako.
segments.ja516:46.1: Kuṭṭhī kilāsī bhavati, yo mittānidha dubbhati [yo mittānaṃ idhaddubhi (sī. aṭṭha.), yo mittānaṃ idha dubbhati (pī.)];
segments.ja516:46.3: Kāyassa bhedā mittaddu [mittadubbhī (syā. ka.)], nirayaṃ sopapajjatīti [so upapajjatīti (sī. syā. pī.)].

lines: Mittāmaccaparibyūḷhoti mittehi ca daḷhabhattīhi amaccehi ca parivuto.
Setanti setakuṭṭhena setaṃ kabarakuṭṭhena vicitraṃ paribhinnena kaṇḍūyanakilāsakuṭṭhena kilāsinaṃ vedanāppattaṃ kadalipaṇṇe nipannaṃ addasa.
Viddhastaṃ koviḷāraṃvāti vaṇamukhehi paggharantena maṃsena viddhastaṃ pupphitakoviḷārasadisaṃ.
Kiṃ kammamakaranti ito pubbe kiṃ kammaṃ akaraṃ, akāsīti attho.
Evaṃ mahāsatto gaganatale candaṃ uṭṭhāpento viya buddhalīḷāya brāhmaṇassa pañhaṃ kathesi.
Mahājano nadanto selento apphoṭento sādhukārasahassāni adāsi, celukkhepe ca aṅguliphoṭe ca pavattesi, hatthapiḷandhanādīni khipi.
Suciratopi nikkhasahassena pūjaṃ katvā suvaṇṇapaṭṭe jātihiṅgulakena pañhavissajjanaṃ likhitvā indapatthanagaraṃ gantvā rañño dhammayāgapañhaṃ kathesi.
Rājā tasmiṃ dhamme vattitvā saggapuraṃ pūresi.

Satthā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ āharitvā “na, bhikkhave, idāneva, pubbepi tathāgato mahāpaññoyevā”ti vatvā jātakaṃ samodhānesi “tadā dhanañcayarājā ānando ahosi, sucirato anuruddho, vidhuro kassapo, bhadrakāro moggallāno, sañcayamāṇavo sāriputto, sambhavapaṇḍito pana ahameva ahosin”ti.
Bārāṇasyaṃ ahū rājāti idaṃ satthā veḷuvane viharanto devadattassa silāpavijjhanaṃ ārabbha kathesi.
Tena hi dhanuggahe payojetvā aparabhāge silāya paviddhāya bhikkhūhi devadattassa avaṇṇe kathite satthā “na, bhikkhave, idāneva, pubbepi devadatto mayhaṃ silaṃ pavijjhiyevā”ti vatvā atītaṃ āhari.
Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente kāsikagāmake eko kassakabrāhmaṇo khettaṃ kasitvā goṇe vissajjetvā kuddālakammaṃ kātuṃ ārabhi.
Goṇā ekasmiṃ gacche paṇṇāni khādantā anukkamena aṭaviṃ pavisitvā palāyiṃsu.
So velaṃ sallakkhetvā kuddālaṃ ṭhapetvā goṇe olokento adisvā domanassappatto te pariyesanto antoaṭaviṃ pavisitvā āhiṇḍanto himavantaṃ pāvisi.
So tattha disāmūḷho hutvā sattāhaṃ nirāhāro vicaranto ekaṃ tindukarukkhaṃ disvā abhiruyha phalāni khādanto tindukarukkhato parigaḷitvā saṭṭhihatthe narakapapāte pati.
Tadā bodhisatto kapiyoniyaṃ nibbattitvā phalāphalāni khādanto taṃ purisaṃ disvā silāya yoggaṃ katvā taṃ purisaṃ uddharitvā silāya matthake nisīdāpetvā evamāha –
“bho brāhmaṇa, ahaṃ kilamāmi, muhuttaṃ niddāyissāmi, maṃ rakkhāhī”ti.
So tassa niddāyantassa silāya matthakaṃ padālesi.

Mahāsatto tassa taṃ kammaṃ ñatvā uppatitvā sākhāya nisīditvā “bho purisa, tvaṃ bhūmiyā gaccha, ahaṃ sākhaggena tuyhaṃ maggaṃ ācikkhanto gamissāmī”ti taṃ purisaṃ araññato nīharitvā magge ṭhapetvā pabbatapādameva pāvisi.
So puriso mahāsatte aparajjhitvā kuṭṭhī hutvā diṭṭhadhammeyeva manussapeto ahosi.
So satta vassāni dukkhapīḷito vicaranto bārāṇasiyaṃ migājinaṃ nāma uyyānaṃ pavisitvā pākārantare kadalipaṇṇaṃ attharitvā vedanāppatto nipajji.
Tadā bārāṇasirājā uyyānaṃ gantvā tattha vicaranto taṃ disvā “kosi tvaṃ, kiṃ vā katvā imaṃ dukkhaṃ patto”ti pucchi.
Avaca byamhito rājā, yakkhānaṃ katamo nusi.
“Hatthapādā ca te setā, tato setataraṃ siro;
Kāḷapabbāva te aṅgā, nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ.
Janetti yāpi te mātā, na taṃ iccheyya passituṃ.
Kibbisaṃ yaṃ karitvāna, idaṃ dukkhaṃ upāgamī”ti.
